easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
You control another creature with toughness equal to 1.
description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to another creature with toughness equal to 1.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature was a Tentacle, and Skullclamp triggers.
Resolve the Watcher trigger, if applicable, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on a permanent.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Tentacle creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Tentacle, adding {1}.
Repeat.
